task.title: Implement unattended post-boundary agency pickup
task.summary: Implement a policy-gated runner path that resumes work after CodeWiki compaction or hard session boundaries without user babysitting when /wiki-config permits.

goal.outcome: Configured agency modes can continue bounded task/sprint/roadmap execution from CodeWiki source refs after safe context boundaries without manual user prompts.
acceptance: Runner consumes codewiki_resume_context packets after safe compaction or new-session boundaries and resumes only when agency policy allows.
Auto-pickup preserves visible tool results, active task/build refs, budgets, approval cadence, and stop conditions.
Hard new-session pickup has adapter/orchestrator path or explicit fallback when Pi command context is unavailable.
Tests cover allowed pickup, blocked pickup, budget exhaustion, approval-required stop, and no mid-loop pickup while intent is unstored.
non_goals: Do not bypass user-configured agency limits.
Do not use chat-history or VCC recall as normal memory.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Auto-pickup preserves visible tool results, active task/build refs, budgets, approval cadence, and stop conditions.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Hard new-session pickup has adapter/orchestrator path or explicit fallback when Pi command context is unavailable.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: planAgencyAutoPickup returns a manual-visible-instructions fallback for hard-new-session when adapterCanDeliver=false; existing /wiki-resume --new command path remains the hard replacement-session adapter path. Smoke test asserts hard-new-session fallback with source-backed kickoff.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tests cover allowed pickup, blocked pickup, budget exhaustion, approval-required stop, and no mid-loop pickup while intent is unstored.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/agency-auto-pickup.test.mjs covers allowed pickup, auto_pickup disabled, session budget exhaustion, task-level approval cadence boundary, unstored intent mid-loop block, and hard new-session fallback.

closure_brief.user_intent: Proceed with TASK-053 after reload: implement unattended post-boundary agency pickup under policy gates.
implemented_changes: Added agency auto-pickup decision module and config helper.
Runtime and Pi compaction now run policy-gated source-backed pickup checks before requesting or sending continuation.
remaining_risks: Auto-pickup remains bounded by adapter lifecycle events and Pi sendMessage capability; unsupported adapters receive fallback decisions instead of continuation.
No auto-restart of Pi is attempted by design.
